title: Egregnosis
listing_description: A proposed framework for studying collective cognition: the ways societies perceive, remember, prioritize, and hallucinate through institutions, prestige, media, and shared models.
reader_hook: Consider a society as a fallible perceptual system and explore what it takes for collective minds to notice the realities their own structures filter out.

source_excerpt.start_heading: Chapter 1 — The Things a Society Cannot See
